title: ResourceSearch responses can be RESOURCE_TABLE or FIELD_VALUES — handle both
answers: Why does my search result parsing miss rows / silently return no hits?
How do I read resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse rows correctly?
Team validation (title uniqueness / folder ownership) not catching conflicts after a server upgrade
What result formats does resource search support?
body: A ResourceSearchResponse's rows live in different places depending on resp.GetResultFormat(): RESOURCE_TABLE (and UNSPECIFIED, for older servers) puts rows in resp.GetResults().GetRows(), while FIELD_VALUES puts rows directly in resp.GetRows(). Any caller that sets ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES on the request must still branch on the response's actual format (not assume the server honored the request) to stay compatible with older servers that only emit RESOURCE_TABLE. Enforced in pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/validate.go:teamSearchResultNames and pkg/services/team/folderownership/validation.go:ValidateNoOwnedFolders, both via a switch over UNSPECIFIED/RESOURCE_TABLE vs FIELD_VALUES with a default error for unknown formats. Skipping the table branch breaks compatibility with pre-upgrade servers; skipping the FIELD_VALUES branch means new-format responses are silently parsed as empty, so uniqueness/ownership conflicts stop being detected.
applies: Any code in Grafana core that calls resourcepb.ResourceIndexClient.Search and reads the rows out of the response.
says: Why does search result parsing lose rows after a server upgrade?
Team validation stopped catching folder ownership problems in search responses
How do I read resource search results from different response formats?
Search parsing breaks silently when result format changes between servers
Results show empty: which response location has the actual search rows?
search: ResourceSearchResponse rows location depends on result format: code calling resourcepb.ResourceIndexClient.Search must branch on response.GetResultFormat() to handle both RESOURCE_TABLE (resp.Results.Rows) and FIELD_VALUES (resp.Rows) locations, even when the request specified FIELD_VALUES. Skipping either branch causes silent data loss or compatibility breaks with older servers. Pattern enforced in pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/validate.go:teamSearchResultNames and pkg/services/team/folderownership/validation.go:ValidateNoOwnedFolders using switch statements over result formats with error handling for unknown formats.
